# Toolbar

> A group of controls that Tab reaches once, with the arrow keys to move between them.

`<slab-toolbar>` · Navigation · built on `[role=toolbar]`

Docs: https://slab-elements.dev/components/toolbar/

## Import

```js
import 'slab-elements/toolbar.js';
```

## Usage

```html
<slab-toolbar label="Formatting">
  <button aria-pressed="false">Bold</button>
  <button aria-pressed="false">Italic</button>
  <button>Link</button>
</slab-toolbar>
```

## Keyboard

| Key         | What it does                                                                                                                      |
| ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Left, Right | Moves to the previous or next control, wrapping and skipping disabled ones. Up and Down instead when `orientation` is "vertical". |
| Home, End   | Moves to the first or last control.                                                                                               |
| Tab         | Leaves the toolbar. Coming back, focus returns to the control focused last.                                                       |

## Elements

### `<slab-toolbar>`

Import `slab-elements/toolbar.js` to register it.

A toolbar with no visual styles: a `[role=toolbar]` around the controls slotted into it, usually `<button>`s, so Tab reaches the group once and the arrow keys move between them.

Exactly one control is tabbable: the one most recently focused, or the first that isn't disabled. Left and Right, or Up and Down when `orientation` is `"vertical"`, move focus between them, wrapping at each end and skipping disabled ones, and Home and End go to the first and last. A control that edits text, such as a text `<input>`, keeps its arrow keys, and so does one that handles a key itself and cancels it. In a right-to-left page, Left and Right swap.

Controls are focused directly, so put ones that take focus themselves in it, such as `<button>`s, `<input>`s and links. A custom element whose focusable part is in its shadow root can't be made untabbable from outside it.

Style it through its part, and the controls directly.

#### Attributes

| Name               | Type                         | Default        | Description                                                                            |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------- | -------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `label` (required) | `string`                     |                | Names the toolbar.                                                                     |
| `orientation`      | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'horizontal'` | Which arrow keys move between the controls. Where they sit is still up to your styles. |

#### Properties

| Name                | Type            | Description                            |
| ------------------- | --------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `items` (read-only) | `HTMLElement[]` | What it moves focus between, in order. |

#### Methods

| Signature                             | Description                                     |
| ------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void` | Focuses it, or the part of it that takes focus. |

#### Slots

| Name      | Type      | Description |
| --------- | --------- | ----------- |
| (default) | `Element` |             |

#### CSS parts

| Name      | Description  |
| --------- | ------------ |
| `toolbar` | The controls |
